notes.title: BUMBI Demo Update 1.5.1.0 - Bugs Squashed!
notes.notes:
[p][b]🐶 Bumbi Patch Notes 🐾[/b]
Thanks for all the feedback on the demo! We've rolled out some much-needed fixes and updates—here’s what’s new in this build:[/p][p][/p][p][b]🎮 Gameplay Tweaks & Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]🐾 [b]Small collider adjustments[/b] to improve movement precision![/p][/*][*][p]🧱 Fixed [b]getting stuck on Level 6[/b] near the end (had the wrong collider whoops).[/p][/*][*][p]🪂 [b]Coyote time[/b] added for [b]wall jumps[/b], giving you that forgiving mid-air wiggle room (you're welcome).[/p][/*][*][p]🎮 [b]Controller joystick down[/b] now lets you [b]slide[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🧊 Pressing down while wall sliding now [b]slides you faster[/b] down the wall. It isn't super noticeable, wondering if I should make this faster? 👀[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🐞 Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]🔄 Fixed [b]input device switching[/b] during menu navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]💾 [b]Settings and save scores now work properly[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🦴 Bones collected during the level now [b]actually show up[/b] (important for bone hoarders).[/p][/*][/list][p]If you have any more feedback or find any pesky bugs, join our Discord so we can get it sorted out!
[url="https://discord.gg/jqnKH3wDj4"]https://discord.gg/jqnKH3wDj4[/url]

Stay tuned for more! 🐕[/p][p][url="https://emojipedia.org/dog"]
[/url][/p]
